answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce head-on exposure and create lateral separation from the incoming threat by executing a sustained descending right break to an easterly beam, then stabilizing there, as both opposing missiles advance southward along the Team A corridor.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to maintain pressure and forward attack geometry by accelerating north-northeast in a sustained descent with only modest heading corrections, rather than joining A0100’s lateral break, while the opposing formation closes head-on and A0200’s already-airborne missile continues ahead on roughly the same axis.
